note: Gate-checkable projection of the QA Checklist in ../../SKILL.md (authoritative). OV-CFACT inherits all OV-CHILD gates; where OV-CFACT tightens a rule, the tighter rule governs. type=python checks are computable via genie_childrens_facts.py; type=manual require agent/render/source inspection.

GATE_1_title_analysis_and_book_lock.text: Age band locked (AB-1 / AB-2-L1 / AB-2-L2 / AB-2-L3 / AB-3) with signal evidence stated
Knowledge depth level locked (KD-1 / KD-2 / KD-3)
Host profile confirmed as CB-FACT; any narrative frame is a guest device <= one-sixth of pages
Trim locked: 8.5 x 11 default or 8.5 x 8.5 (illustrated only) with justification
Target page count set and even; KDP minimum 24 confirmed
Fact count claim extracted from title and recorded; minimum fact production target set
Superlative inventory complete (all superlatives in title/concept noted and flagged)
Curiosity Map (section sequence, familiar -> exotic) drafted and recorded in Book Lock
Facts-per-spread target within OV-CFACT limits (max 8 per spread)
Type floors recorded for body, callout/Wow, gloss, caption - all above minimums
Full color confirmed; section accent colors planned (4-8); bleed flag ON with bleed dims recorded
Dual-source verification protocol ACTIVE; child-safety battery PENDING; read-aloud flag set

GATE_2_manuscript_and_fact_verification.text: All sections complete per Curiosity Map; order follows curiosity logic (familiar -> exotic)
Every themed spread follows the Fact-Spread Unit: header + anchor + cluster + Wow Callout + optional Quiz
Total individually numbered facts equals or exceeds the title count claim
No fact appears on a page without thematic context (no orphan facts)
Verification log complete: every fact has two independent authoritative sources recorded
Every superlative verified; volatile superlatives dated inline in text
All quantities/statistics/dimensions verified and hedged; unit consistency confirmed
Every abstract concept followed immediately by a concrete analogy
Quick Quiz answerable from spread content; answers immediately adjacent; no 'see page X'
Stretch-word count per spread within limits; on-page gloss on every spread with a stretch word
Glossary, source list (>=2 per major fact), index (AB-3/KD-3 or KD-2 >64pp), Further Reading complete
Read-aloud cadence test PASSED (AB-1 and AB-2-L1) or NOT APPLICABLE
Child-appropriateness battery PASSED incl. OV-CFACT extensions (death/predation, human body, history, environment, scary content)
Final spread delivers the most astonishing fact in the book

GATE_3_interior_design_art_layout.text: One distinct hue per section; all pass AA contrast; colorblind sim run on diagrams/bands
Fact-spread layouts follow the 12-layer template; no body text below the quiet-zone/panel layer
Every illustration/photo brief stated the exact reserved zone BEFORE art was generated
All headers, facts, callouts, quiz, gloss, captions, and diagram labels are real editable type - no AI lettering
All diagram labels real typeset with a title and scale indicator where relevant
Sidebars on no more than 40% of spreads; all visually subordinate to anchor fact
Photo vs. illustration treatment consistent per Book Lock; no random alternation
Running fact-number badge (if count-claim book) visible and consistently positioned
Bleed art extends to media edge; odd pages bleed right, even bleed left; correct bleed dims
Critical content inside trim + 0.5 in safe zone; grayscale proof of colored text pages passes
Thumbnail, 100%-render, and spread-view reviews pass; no source-identifying resemblance to references

GATE_4_production_preflight_release.text: Even page count within KDP range; premium color confirmed <72pp / standard 72+
Numbered facts in final PDF equal or exceed title claim
All volatile superlatives dated in final text; no undated volatile superlative remains
Verification log confirmed complete and available for internal record
Fixed-layout export; MediaBox/BleedBox cover bleed page; TrimBox parity-correct; no crop marks
All fonts embedded, no substituted glyphs; all images >=300 DPI at placed size
Text extraction/preflight confirms real type throughout; no AI lettering
Physical proof ordered and reviewed (trim, paper, accent saturation, spread gutter, Wow legibility)
KDP AI-disclosure met; child-safety battery re-confirmed; all gate statuses current with evidence
